svg.title: Flame graph: a 32,768-token prompt in 8 chunks (21 s of GPU time)
svg.desc: A flame graph of one forward pass's GPU time from Instruments' Metal System Trace: the request at the bottom, then chunks, layers, blocks, steps and MLX kernels stacked above, each frame as wide as its share of 21496 ms. Open the SVG on its own to hover frames and click to zoom.
